latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Free Download Online.

- Instantly create and export MP4 videos from your uploaded images or clips, all in-browser with no app install required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB; AI automatically generates videos with music, text overlays, and more.
- Simple session management: connect with a free, temporary token—no account needed for casual use (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Cloud GPU rendering delivers finished 1080p videos in 30–90 seconds, then provides a download link.
- Built-in workflows for upload, edit, preview, credits check, and export; errors and status reported clearly.
- Designed for creators and small businesses who want quick, easy video production online.
